objective: Preallocate join data and index prefixes from known component lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate join prefixes
tasks.result: Join planning and indexed join probes now use explicit-capacity helpers instead of format! for scan prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The data-prefix helper reserves capacity for data:<table>:.
The index-prefix helper reserves capacity for index:<table>:<column>:<value>:.
The optimization replaces format! in indexed join probe prefix construction and comma-join row-count fallback prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, index scans, row-count fallback, join probe rows, projection behavior, join ordering, and SQL results are unchanged.
